installer-gui-script.title: Alfred – A simple Denoiser at your Service

choice.title: VST3
choice.description: Alfred as VST3 plug-in, for REAPER and most other hosts. Goes to /Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/VST3.

choice.title: Audio Unit
choice.description: Alfred as Audio Unit, for Logic Pro, GarageBand and other hosts that use Audio Units. Goes to /Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/Components.

choice.title: CLAP
choice.description: Alfred as CLAP plug-in, for REAPER, Bitwig Studio and other hosts that support CLAP. Goes to /Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/CLAP.

choice.title: Neural voice engine
choice.description: The files the neural voice engine needs, shared by all formats (about 70 MB, needs macOS 13 or newer). Without them Alfred works with its classic engine only.

choice.title: Enhance model: Restore
choice.description: Studio voice restoration, worked out when you render (about 36 MB). Needs the neural voice engine files. License: OpenRAIL (restore-LICENSE-OpenRAIL.txt is installed with it). You accepted it on the License page; switch this off if you do not want its terms.

choice.title: Enhance model: Sidon
choice.description: Builds the voice anew in studio quality, worked out when you render; slow (about 300 MB). Needs the neural voice engine files. MIT License.
